rationale: C16 is a nearly verbatim country-substitution template for the child. Both invoke the same statutes, make the same World War II disruption and reciprocal-treatment findings, cover registrations expiring within the same date range, and extend renewal through December 31, 1948. C12 and C08 use the same machinery and language but prescribe an earlier June 30 deadline, making C16 the closest concrete drafting source.
